integrity: The proof cites the known general generation criterion and idempotent conjugacy as inputs. Independent external mathematical validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counting theorem for finite posets over finite fields and unital ordered idempotent tuples. It does not classify conjugacy classes, give a generally polynomial-time algorithm, or apply to arbitrary coefficient rings. Finite checks are evidence, not an infinite proof. Complete text of the nearest 2024 source was inaccessible; originality priority is provisional.
title: Hamming-cover polynomial counts ordered idempotent generators of finite incidence algebras
